assay: bulk RNA-seq of human cardiac organoids (hPSC-CM/hcFB/HUVEC/hADSC), n=3 vehicle vs n=3 IL-1beta, day 4 of treatment
primary_estimand: Transcriptomic effect of 4-day IL-1beta stimulation vs vehicle in human cardiac organoids (COVID-19 cytokine-storm model). No exercise estimand: the only 'simulated exercise' is a functional norepinephrine stress test (beating rate/FAC, S2.6.p2, FIG7d-g) that has no transcriptome.
planned_contrasts: IL-1beta vs control hCOs (S2.1.p2, FIG2d volcano; paper DEG count not stated)
exercise_contrast_in_paper: none for RNA-seq; NE 'stress test to simulate physiological exercise' is beating-rate only (S2.6.p2)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S5.p2 (only generic p<0.05 t-test rule for non-omics assays); FIG2d gives no DEG rule

paper_method: not stated for RNA-seq; Median-of-Ratios normalization (FIG3c) suggests DESeq2
paper_results: IL1R1 up in IL-1beta hCOs (S2.1.p2); ADRB2 up, ADRB1 unchanged (S2.6.p2)
